dct_title_s: France--west coast, approaches to Saint-Nazaire, including entrance to the Loire (Raster Image)
dct_description_sm: Prepared and published by the National Imagery and Mapping Agency. Depths shown by isolines and soundings. Relief shown by contours and spot heights. "From a French chart of 1995." "Soundings in meters." Map no.37363. Includes tidal currents and information charts.
This map is part of a collection of scanned and georeferenced nautical charts produced by the National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency (NGA).
